location: Abstract; GLEE and the competition objective
claim_summary: Expected payoff and expected raw percentile can rank actions differently under a fixed nondecreasing empirical-percentile map
limitation: Evidence status: identity. Scope and denominator: finite mathematical construction under a fixed raw-rank map, not an estimated GLEE cell and not the undisclosed opponent adjustment. Evidence object: paper/appendix.tex Proposition Expected payoff can reverse expected raw rank and Figure rank.
requested_action: Allowed wording: Expected payoff and expected raw percentile can prefer different actions under a fixed nondecreasing raw-rank map. Do not call this a theorem about final leaderboard position or arbitrary opponent adjustment.

claim_summary: Expected adjusted percentile orders the one-step rating update under a fixed adjustment, positive step size, and inactive clamp
limitation: Evidence status: identity. Scope and denominator: one normally completed nonabandoned game with fixed current rating, positive eta, fixed opponent adjustment, and inactive clamp. It excludes penalties, voids, decay, changing pools, and cross-rating comparisons. Evidence object: paper/appendix.tex Proposition Rating equivalence.
requested_action: Allowed wording: Under the stated fixed-map and inactive-clamp assumptions, expected one-step rating is ordered by expected adjusted percentile, not expected money.

location: Final submitted strategy; competition outcomes; limitations
claim_summary: The two final-profile windows carry 28.99 percent, 3.73 percent, and 10.25 percent of endpoint raw-rating weight in bargaining, negotiation, and persuasion
limitation: Evidence status: identity. Scope and denominator: mature eta=.002 kernel applied to 171 bargaining, 19 negotiation, and 54 rated persuasion games, conditional on no penalty or clamp. Calculation is 1-(1-.002)^n. Evidence objects: paper/appendix.tex rating-kernel derivation and paper/data/final_policy_two_window_census.csv.
requested_action: Allowed wording: Under the documented mature update kernel and absent penalties or clamps, the two windows contributed 28.99, 3.73, and 10.25 percent raw-rating weight by family. This is material exposure but not an isolated causal policy evaluation.

location: Abstract; final submitted strategy; competition outcomes; conclusion
claim_summary: The endpoint ratings evaluate an adaptively developed participant trajectory rather than an isolated final configuration
limitation: Evidence status: live descriptive plus identity. Scope and denominator: 46,564 public focal-profile games accumulated under changing strategies, compared with 245 assignments in the two complete final-profile windows. Evidence objects: paper/data/submitted_agent_leaderboard_snapshot.csv, paper/data/final_policy_two_window_census.csv, and the rating-kernel derivation.
requested_action: Allowed wording: The endpoint is external validation of a competitive adaptive system or trajectory. Do not say that the final configured policy caused, earned, or independently validates the lifetime ratings.

location: Final submitted strategy; Agent Behavior Analysis
claim_summary: Placement was account-level and adaptively selected by the best active in-account profile
limitation: Evidence status: live descriptive and platform rule. Scope and denominator: one participant account ranked by its best active profile; the paper inventory contains the focal profile and four historical development profiles but is not a census of every identity ever activated. The focal profile is not an ex ante held-out agent. Evidence objects: docs/reference/glee-docs.md and paper/appendix.tex archive-coverage section.
requested_action: Allowed wording: Results are account-level and selected by the best active profile; ratings and counts belong to the focal profile that supplied the account maximum. Do not assert exactly five lifetime identities or call the focal profile held out.

claim_summary: The two audited exposure windows used the same recorded overlay with an ordered deterministic dispatcher, post-routing coercion and guards, and a legal fallback
limitation: Evidence status: code-linked. Scope and denominator: reviewed source, unchanged recorded overlay, 81 overlay values, six defaults, 23 hashed assets, and 2,288 local action records. The archive lacks a complete PID-to-commit-to-server manifest for every action. Evidence objects: paper/data/submitted_agent_bank_manifest.csv, paper/data/final_policy_two_window_census.csv, paper/data/submitted_policy_asset_manifest.csv, glee_agent/dispatch.py, and glee_agent/actions.py.
requested_action: Allowed wording: The two windows shared the recorded configuration and relevant tracked policy source, implementing an ordered deterministic dispatcher with final coercion and fallback. Do not claim one continuously frozen binary or universal server receipt.

claim_summary: The two final-profile windows were configured to use no LLM at inference time
limitation: Evidence status: code-linked. Scope and denominator: LLM_MODE=off in the dated manifest and launch records, heuristic source tags across 2,288 own action records, and dispatch code that calls the optional LLM layer only when configured. The missing complete PID-to-commit manifest prevents a universal lifetime process claim. Evidence objects: paper/data/submitted_agent_bank_manifest.csv, paper/data/final_policy_two_window_census.csv, and glee_agent/dispatch.py.
requested_action: Allowed wording: Both complete final-profile windows were configured LLM-off, and all 2,288 local action records carry heuristic rather than LLM source tags. Avoid extending this statement to every historical development game without provenance.

claim_summary: Only two retained subcomponents directly optimized a local raw-rank proxy; other policy owners targeted money, agreement, or safety
limitation: Evidence status: code-linked. Scope and denominator: disclosed owner groups in the dated bank, with direct local-rank objectives in the bargaining Bob-offer floor and hidden one-round seller only. Neither includes the undisclosed opponent adjustment. Evidence objects: paper/appendix.tex Table Objective and evidence class of each retained owner group, glee_agent/barg_offer.py, and glee_agent/first_principles.py.
requested_action: Allowed wording: Two retained subcomponents directly optimized local raw-rank proxies; the overall policy was rank-aware but not a global rank optimizer. Do not imply every branch optimized percentile or official adjusted rank.

claim_summary: Two complete final-profile exposure windows contain 245 joined games, 244 public rated-game increments, one timeout, 2,288 own action records, and zero logged errors
limitation: Evidence status: live descriptive. Scope and denominator: the complete August 29 pre-close window and August 30 closing window. Counts are 171 bargaining, 19 negotiation, and 55 persuasion assignments; one persuasion timeout leaves 244 public game-count increments. Evidence objects: paper/data/final_policy_two_window_census.csv and canonical local joins.
requested_action: Allowed wording: The local archive provides a complete bounded two-window process and outcome census with 245 assignments, 2,288 own actions, one timeout, and zero logged errors. Do not call it a universal conformance census or an effectiveness estimate.

claim_summary: The complete two-window census verifies bounded process coverage, while owner-to-wire execution alignment is supported only on separately audited states
limitation: Evidence status: live descriptive plus code-linked forensic cohorts. Scope and denominator: 245-game census for process and terminal coverage; separate pooled live bargaining, negotiation simulation, and persuasion replay or selected live cohorts for owner-level alignment. No lifetime owner-to-server denominator exists.
requested_action: Allowed wording: The two-window census establishes process and outcome coverage, and separate audits establish sampled execution alignment. Do not say the final agent behaved as designed across all games, owners, states, or server receipts.

claim_summary: The local behavioral unit is the legal post-coercion action returned to the SDK, and action-changing reach requires positive eligible, fired, and changed-action counts
limitation: Evidence status: code-linked. Scope and denominator: local returned actions and configured trace events. A returned SDK action is not itself a server acknowledgment, and official equality is established only for joined subsets. Evidence objects: glee_agent/dispatch.py, glee_agent/actions.py, strategy gate tracing, and scripts/check_reachability.py.
requested_action: Allowed wording: The audit contract treats the post-coercion returned action as the local behavioral object and refuses outcome interpretation when eligibility, firing, or action change is zero. Do not equate local return with server receipt.

claim_summary: The returned-action audit caused or generally produces strong competition performance
limitation: Evidence status: limitation. Scope and denominator: one adaptive account in one competition. The case documents unreachable gates, leakage, overwrite, and parser failures, but has no development comparison with and without the audit process.
requested_action: Allowed wording: The audit made implementation claims falsifiable and prevented or reversed specific unsupported interpretations. Do not say it caused the ratings, placement, or competitive success.

location: Abstract; Agent Behavior Analysis; selection table
claim_summary: The narrow bargaining owner changed all 153 eligible returned actions in the pooled live audit
limitation: Evidence status: code-linked live descriptive. Scope and denominator: 153 eligible turns across 25 finalized live games on three in-account profiles sharing one copied stack; 23 agreements and two zeros or no-deals. Evidence objects: .ai/HANDOFF.md final bargaining reachability audit and paper/review_artifact/data/outcome_summary.csv.
requested_action: Allowed wording: In a pooled three-profile live audit, the narrow owner changed 153 of 153 eligible returned actions. Keep the pooled profile scope explicit and do not call it a focal-profile or two-window census.

claim_summary: The narrow bargaining owner's terminal-cent offer was accepted in eight of ten games that reached it
limitation: Evidence status: live descriptive. Scope and denominator: selected games in the pooled 25-game three-profile audit that reached the terminal-cent action. Reach is post-policy selected and does not estimate the offer's causal effect or general acceptance probability.
requested_action: Allowed wording: The terminal-cent action closed 8 of 10 pooled audited games that reached it. Label this selected reached-state evidence, not a success rate for the policy or evidence of rating lift.

claim_summary: The negotiation owner fired in 6,188 of 6,188 simulated decision states and changed 3,274 returned actions across 800 simulated games
limitation: Evidence status: code-linked simulation. Scope and denominator: 800 sampled simulated games and 6,188 simulated decision states under the audited stack. This is not a live frequency or field-value estimate. Evidence objects: .ai/HANDOFF.md negotiation reachability record and paper/review/theory_code_audit.md.
requested_action: Allowed wording: In 800 simulated games, the owner fired in all 6,188 eligible decision states and changed 3,274 returned actions. Always label the denominator as simulated decision states.

claim_summary: Selected simulated terminal negotiation offers with positive modeled opponent gain were accepted in 1,489 of 1,493 cases and those without positive gain in zero of 159
limitation: Evidence status: simulation descriptive. Scope and denominator: selected simulated terminal response states under the audited opponent behavior, not live randomized offers. Reached states are policy selected and the finding does not identify field value.
requested_action: Allowed wording: In the selected simulation audit, modeled positive-opponent-gain terminal offers were accepted in 1,489 of 1,493 cases and nonpositive offers in 0 of 159. Do not present this as a live acceptance probability or causal effect.

claim_summary: The tight credibility reset changed 6,718 replayed turns across 877 historical games
limitation: Evidence status: code-linked replay. Scope and denominator: 6,718 action changes in 877 replayed games, including changes in both directions. It is not a two-window field census or rating-effect estimate. Evidence object: .ai/EXPERIMENTS.md tight-credibility-reset replay record.
requested_action: Allowed wording: In historical replay, the reset changed 6,718 turns across 877 games. Keep replay and bidirectional action-change status explicit.

claim_summary: In the complete pre-close subcohort, one of four text-buyer games contained four repeated strict warnings missed by V1; the policy bought all four and all four revealed LOW quality
limitation: Evidence status: live descriptive counterexample. Scope and denominator: four text-mode buyer games with 80 decisions in the complete August 29 subcohort; four repeated warnings occurred within one game. This establishes coverage failure, not warning prevalence, parser recall, or a rating effect.
requested_action: Allowed wording: The pre-close subcohort contains a concrete V1 coverage failure: four repeated strict warnings in one text-buyer game were followed by four purchases, all revealed LOW. Do not generalize beyond the four counterexamples.

claim_summary: A frozen focal-profile slice found 146 post-hoc strict warnings outside V1 and 40 V1-path purchases across 21 games, all of which revealed LOW quality
limitation: Evidence status: live descriptive counterexamples with post-hoc selectors. Scope and denominator: 14,900 buyer/text decisions in a frozen focal-profile slice; the 40 purchases are conditional on the V1 path and selected warnings. No annotation-based recall denominator or treatment contrast exists. Evidence objects: paper/data/persuasion_parser_coverage.csv and paper/appendix.tex warning coverage audit.
requested_action: Allowed wording: Post-hoc selectors identified 146 strict warning counterexamples outside V1; among 40 V1-path purchases in 21 games, all revealed LOW. Call these counterexamples, not recall, failure rate, or rating effect.

claim_summary: Complete-information negotiation closed more often than hidden-information negotiation in a historical in-account pool, and reconstructed support contains fewer feasible hidden type pairs
limitation: Evidence status: live descriptive plus identity under a reconstructed model. Scope and denominator: historical in-account pool of 805 complete and 2,295 hidden games; reconstructed support feasible in 6 of 6 complete cells and 6 of 16 hidden type pairs under independent-uniform types. The close-rate contrast is observational and the type-pair percentage is model conditional.
requested_action: Allowed wording: In the declared historical pool, complete-information games closed 91.8 percent versus 29.6 percent under hidden information; the reconstructed support is feasible in 6 of 6 complete cells and 6 of 16 hidden pairs. Do not state that hidden information causally reduced closing or that 37.5 percent is an organizer-published field frequency.

claim_summary: Three then-leading public negotiation profiles shared extreme opening patterns in 154 directly observed games
limitation: Evidence status: live descriptive. Scope and denominator: 154 direct games against three then-leading public profiles, with hidden multi-round first-offer summaries based on 30 seller and 30 buyer openings. Opponent identities and private types were only partly exposed.
requested_action: Allowed wording: Direct games against three then-leading profiles supplied a shared extreme-opening hypothesis. Do not claim that the pattern caused their ratings or that scaled private-value trajectories were directly observed.

location: Competition outcomes and findings; selection table
claim_summary: The broad leader-derived buyer clone improved rating
limitation: Evidence status: hash-assigned contrast. Scope and denominator: stopped 91-game read after an earlier n=45 look; candidate n=44 and control n=47 across four in-account profile strata. Difference +0.869 rating per game with unadjusted fixed-z interval [-0.730,2.469], no-deals +6.141 percentage points, and one negative focal stratum. The deidentified artifact preserves assigned arm but not game IDs, so assignment cannot be independently re-derived. The study failed its frozen promotion rule.
requested_action: Allowed wording: The hash-assigned candidate-control point contrast was +0.869 rating per game, but its unadjusted interval after two looks crossed zero, no-deals increased, one stratum was negative, and the candidate failed promotion. Call it inconclusive and rejected, not beneficial.

claim_summary: Displayed ratings and fitted same-cell percentiles reversed across time even under the same or near-identical stack
limitation: Evidence status: observational chronology. Scope and denominator: authenticated dated rating checkpoints plus one unchanged development-profile bargaining stack with consecutive fitted windows n=471 and n=498, moving from .5668 to .5038 while agreement remained 99.6 percent. The field and reference pool were nonstationary.
requested_action: Allowed wording: Ratings seesawed, and one unchanged bargaining stack's fitted same-cell percentile fell from .5668 to .5038 across consecutive windows. Use this as evidence of nonstationarity, not a treatment effect of any heuristic.

claim_summary: The broad observed-gain bargaining floor was negative on all three controlled arena seeds
limitation: Evidence status: controlled diagnostic. Scope and denominator: three arena seeds under the stated simulator and control stack with estimated percentile contrasts -.0012, -.0013, and -.0006. Arena evidence is not a live field-effect estimate. Evidence object: .ai/FINDINGS.md Bargaining delay guards.
requested_action: Allowed wording: The broad observed-gain floor was negative on all three controlled arena seeds and remained off. Call it a simulator diagnostic, not a general theorem or live causal estimate.

claim_summary: A faster negotiation seller concession exponent of 1.2 was worse than the slower 2.0 fallback
limitation: Evidence status: limitation. Scope and denominator: two earlier diagnostic seeds reported -.0166 and -.0182, but a later clone audit invalidated ask-moving measurements and V2 holdouts disagreed on the Boulware sign. Evidence objects: .ai/FINDINGS.md, .ai/REDTEAM_LOG.md correction, and .ai/TEST4_EXPERIMENT.md.
requested_action: Allowed wording: Earlier two-seed diagnostics disfavored exponent 1.2, but later audits left the sign unproven. Remove the current claim that faster concession was established negative or present it only as an invalidated development result.

claim_summary: At official close the focal profile displayed family ratings of 2804.82, 2620.36, and 2344.87 after 15,639, 15,415, and 15,510 rated games, with mean 2590.02
limitation: Evidence status: final live descriptive. Scope and denominator: stable post-close focal-profile endpoint and official public participant-account snapshot after 2026-08-30 11:59:59 UTC. Ratings summarize the adaptive lifetime trajectory and account selection by its best active profile. Evidence objects: paper/data/submitted_agent_rating_checkpoints.csv and paper/data/submitted_agent_leaderboard_snapshot.csv.
requested_action: Allowed wording: Report the exact final ratings and counts as the endpoint of the focal profile within the adaptive account. Do not call them an isolated final-policy evaluation.

claim_summary: At official close the participant account finished second in the agent track and third on the combined human-agent board
limitation: Evidence status: final external result. Scope and denominator: official agent-track and combined public leaderboard snapshots retrieved after the 2026-08-30 11:59:59 UTC close; focal profile rating 2590.02 after 46,564 games. Evidence object: paper/data/submitted_agent_leaderboard_snapshot.csv.
requested_action: Allowed wording: At official close, the participant account finished second in the agent track and third on the combined board. Keep account placement distinct from focal-profile ratings and do not imply that placement identifies component effects.

claim_summary: The paper and current review artifact reproduce the complete production strategy and empirical result
limitation: Evidence status: limitation. Scope and denominator: source commit, configuration hashes, 81 overlay values, six defaults, 23 asset hashes, final aggregate leaderboard values, the deidentified two-window census, clone table, and deterministic arithmetic checks. The current review artifact does not establish production-equivalent source, every server join, game-level assignment derivation, or independent reconstruction of all empirical claims.
requested_action: Allowed wording: The paper supplies an implementation-linked specification and a sanitized artifact that reproduces final aggregate arithmetic, the two-window census, and disclosed branches. Do not call the full production strategy, complete empirical result, or lifetime action history reproducible until the missing production-equivalent and provenance assets are released and verified.

claim_summary: Routing by observability and auditing returned actions is a validated method for other live competitions
limitation: Evidence status: limitation. Scope and denominator: one participant account, one GLEE competition, one adaptive development process, and incomplete lifetime provenance. No cross-competition validation exists.
requested_action: Allowed wording: Present observability-based routing and returned-action auditing as design principles supported by this case study or as a transferable hypothesis. Do not call them universally necessary or externally validated.

claim_summary: The bounded named-record cohort contains 35 records with the reported reach, live, and disposition flow
limitation: Evidence status: code-linked registry identity. Scope and denominator: 35 normalized named records after collapsing deployment updates and rearm epochs; it is not a census of every exploratory plot, threshold, handoff-only candidate, or idea. Evidence object: paper/data/experiment_registry_crosswalk.csv.
requested_action: Allowed wording: The normalized named-record registry contains 35 records with the reported flow. Keep the exclusion boundary explicit.

location: Competition result, failures, and conclusion; Appendix rejected studies
claim_summary: A selected 352-decision hidden-offer replay had a positive diagnostic direction, while a corrected fixed-history replay retaining realized continuation over 375 exposed decisions reversed the sign
limitation: Evidence status: unreproduced archival diagnostic. Scope and denominator: the private REG-023 experiment record reports two retrospectively selected estimands with 352 and 375 exposed decisions. The corrected analysis retained realized continuation, but its derived rows, first-exposure join, and resampling recipe were not preserved in the review artifact. Evidence objects: .ai/EXPERIMENTS.md REG-023, .ai/FINDINGS.md, and paper/data/experiment_registry_crosswalk.csv.
requested_action: Allowed wording: An archived corrected replay over 375 exposed decisions reversed the positive direction of an earlier 352-decision diagnostic and rejected the policy argument before deployment. Do not report a reproducible interval, cohort average, causal effect, or independently audited sign.
